meta.name: p-video
meta.description: Generate videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Video, WAN-T2V, WAN-I2V. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, audio support, 720p/1080p, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna video, p-video, pruna ai video, fast video generation, optimized video, wan t2v, wan i2v, economic video generation, cheap video generation, pruna text to video, pruna image to video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片快速生成高清视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量视频而无需复杂编辑
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality videos from text or images quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality videos quickly without complex editing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行生成视频。支持文字转视频、图片转视频，可添加音频，输出 720p 或 1080p 画质。
howto.when: 当你提到“pruna video”、“p-video”、“wan t2v”等关键词，或要求生成视频时触发。

say.text: 用 pruna/p-video 生成一段日落时森林的航拍视频。
say.note: 会调用 P-Video 模型生成 5 秒视频。

say.text: 用 wan-t2v 生成一只猫玩毛线球的视频，720p。
say.note: 会调用 WAN-T2V 模型，更经济。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate videos via command line. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, audio input, and outputs up to 1080p.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "pruna video", "p-video", "wan t2v", or ask to generate a video.

say_en.text: Generate a drone shot flying over a forest at sunset using pruna/p-video.
say_en.note: Calls P-Video model for a 5-second video.

say_en.text: Use wan-t2v to create a video of a cat playing with yarn, 720p.
